properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued November 6 at 5:42PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Caribbean waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the
coastal waters of Saint Croix...

* At 542 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated a group of strong
thunderstorms, capable of producing winds to around 30 knots and
possible waterspouts. These strong thunderstorms were located about
40 NM south of Guanica, moving northeast at 15 knots.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly open waters of Caribbean waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to
17N, including the coastal waters of Saint Croix.
properties.instruction:
Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or nearest law enforcement
agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
office.

Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, lightning strikes, heavy downpours, and possible waterspouts.
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until this storm passes.
properties.area: Caribbean Waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the Coastal Waters of Saint Croix
